title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
abstract: arXiv:2609.15471v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a central approach for improving mathematical reasoning in language models, but long-form completions introduce a difficult credit-assignment problem: different parts of a solution trace may contribute unevenly to final correctness. Existing policyoptimization objectives for RLVR commonly apply importance-sampling correction at either the token level (GRPO, DAPO) or the sequence level (GSPO), imposing different granularities for assigning credit across a response. We introduce Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization (HISPO), a segment-level policy-optimization method that constructs rollout-time entropy-derived contiguous segments, assigns soft entropy-based saliency weights, and applies clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment granularity. translated_title: HISPO：基于熵推导分段的层次化重要性采样策略优化
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升语言模型数学推理能力的核心方法，但长篇补全会带来一个困难的信用分配问题：解答轨迹的不同部分对最终正确性的贡献可能不均匀。现有的RLVR策略优化目标通常在词元级别（GRPO、DAPO）或序列级别（GSPO）应用重要性采样修正，从而在为响应分配信用时施加了不同的粒度。我们提出了层次化重要性采样策略优化（HISPO），这是一种段级别的策略优化方法，它在推理采样时构建由熵推导的连续分段，分配基于熵的软显著性权重，并在段粒度上应用裁剪的重要性采样修正。这提供了介于词元级别的GRPO/DAPO和序列级别的GSPO之间的中间修正单元。我们进行评估……
tldr: 本文提出HISPO，一种段级别的策略优化方法，通过熵推导的连续分段和基于熵的显著性权重，在词元级（GRPO/DAPO）与序列级（GSPO）的重要性采样修正之间提供中间粒度，从而改善语言模型数学推理中的信用分配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HISPO, a segment-level policy optimization method that constructs entropy-derived contiguous segments with entropy-based saliency weights, providing an intermediate importance-sampling correction granularity between token-level (GRPO/DAPO) and sequence-level (GSPO) approaches for better credit assignment in language model mathematical reasoning.
